sentences.text: The accused-revisionist is a former two-times Member of Parliament and one-time Member of Legislative Assembly.
He has a rich horoscope of heinous offences and bears a long criminal history of 81 criminal cases to his credit, which includes 15 murder cases.
Such a dreaded criminal has been enjoying the freedom obviously because of his political might and patronage.
He has been recently convicted and sentenced with life imprisonment by the learned trial court at Jaunpur.
This is the first case where the Court could convict the accused-revisionist for the first time in his 46 years of long innings in the criminal world.
6. The present case was registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. on a direction of the Superintendent of Police, Jaunpur.

The allegation against the accused-revisionist is that on the basis of forged and fabricated documents, he got transferred the land of the complainant and got the mutation effected in his favour in the revenue record.
After completion of the investigation, charge sheet was filed against the accused-revisionist and other co-accused.

Thereafter, accused-revisionist has filed a discharge application, which was rejected by the learned trial court considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case and the evidence available on record.

7. At the time of consideration of the discharge/framing of charge, the Court is required to consider the material and evidence collected during the course of investigation to find out whether prima facie case against the accused is made out or not.

8. Sri R.P. Yadav, learned counsel for the accused-revisionist submits that the accused-revisionist was a public servant being Member of Parliament and without sanction from the competent authority for prosecution of the accused-revisionist, the order of cognizance could not have been passed.
9. From the memo of revision, it is evident that the said point was not taken before the trial Court.
The question of sanction/validity of sanction, can be taken by the accused-revisionist at an appropriate stage of the trial which shall be dealt with by the trial court.

10. From a reading of the impugned judgment and order of the learned trial court, it does not appear to be passed without considering the law or appear to have been passed in violation of its jurisdiction.
Therefore, this Court does not find any ground to interfere with the impugned judgment and order by exercising its revisional powers.
11. Thus, the present criminal revision is dismissed.
